instruction_forms_kind: Harness language forms derived from the cited atomic descriptions by splitting action clauses and substituting scene entity names. Form skill_keys and skill_reference_tasks are harness retrieval associations to the composite catalog's skill keys, not additional upstream atomic annotations or evidence of policy competence. Full atomic descriptions are also accepted with their documented placeholders and alternatives instantiated.
